<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Get a campaign run's report"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/run/{id}/report"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the full report of a campaign run: its summary and spec, each attack run with its own outcomes, the breakdowns by technique and by goal category, the judge audit, and the summary of the latest earlier completed run of the same campaign. With `run_id`, the outcomes cover that attack run only. Accepts a login token or an API key (not a run token). Every response has a weak `ETag`: send it back as `If-None-Match` to get `304` without a body while nothing changed.
